attract.title: Check in for your visit.
attract.lede: Tap anywhere to begin. It takes about a minute.
attract.invitationHint: Have an invitation? Just scan its QR code below the screen.

start.title: How would you like to check in?
start.inviteText: Scan the QR code from your invitation email or calendar.
start.walkupText: Enter your details and we'll let your host know you're here.

scan.title: Scan your invitation.
scan.lede: Hold the QR code on your phone about 10 cm below the screen, where the scanner glows.

invite.title: Welcome, {name}.
invite.lede: Please check that these details are right.

company.title: Which company are you with?
company.lede: Optional — leave it empty if you're visiting privately.
company.label: Company

host.title: Who are you visiting?
host.label: Search by name or team
host.empty: No one found. Check the spelling or call reception.

document.title: Place your ID on the reader.
document.lede: Passport photo page down, or an ID card face down, on the glass to the right of the screen.
document.doneLede: Your document has been read. You can take it back now.

face.title: Let's take your badge photo.
face.lede: Look at the camera above the screen and keep your face inside the circle.
face.goodLede: This photo will be printed on your visitor badge.
face.failLede: We couldn't confirm a live photo. Remove sunglasses or a hat and face the camera. {left} tries left.
face.exhausted: We couldn't take your photo. Please call reception and we'll help you.

consent.title: Review and sign.
consent.privacyText: {company} records your name, company, host, ID document details and photo to manage building security. Your data is sent encrypted to our visitor system and erased from this kiosk immediately. It is kept for 30 days unless the law requires otherwise. You can ask reception for access or deletion at any time.
consent.rulesText: Wear your badge visibly at all times and return it when you leave. Stay with your host outside public areas. Photography is not permitted. Anything confidential you see or hear during your visit must not be shared.
consent.acceptPrivacy: I have read the privacy notice
consent.acceptRules: I accept the site rules and confidentiality agreement

submit.title: Checking you in…
submit.lede: Sending your details securely and letting your host know.

done.title: You're all set, {name}.
done.notified: {host} has been notified and will meet you here shortly.
done.pending: Reception will confirm your visit in a moment. Please take a seat.
done.queued: We're offline right now, so reception will notify {host} for you.
done.badgeText: Take it from the slot below. Badge {number}, valid until {until}.
done.badgeTextProvisional: Take it from the slot below. Badge {number}, provisional until reception confirms.
done.passText: Scan to add your visit to your phone.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.text: For your privacy, we'll clear your details soon.

call.callingText: Someone will be with you in a moment.
call.connectedText: Speak normally — the microphones are above the screen.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again or call reception.
errors.agent_unreachable: The kiosk is restarting. Please wait a moment.
errors.vms_offline: We can't reach the visitor system right now. Please call reception.
errors.invitation_not_found: We couldn't find that invitation. Try again or enter your details.
errors.document_timeout: We didn't see a document. Place it on the reader and try again.
errors.document_unreadable: We couldn't read that document. Try again, photo page down.
errors.document_expired: This document has expired. Please call reception.
errors.document_unsupported: This document isn't supported. Please call reception.
errors.camera_unavailable: The camera isn't available. Please call reception.
errors.face_attempts_exhausted: We couldn't take your photo. Please call reception.
errors.consent_required: Please accept both agreements and sign.
errors.vms_rejected: Your check-in couldn't be completed. Please call reception.
errors.offline_queue_full: The kiosk can't store more check-ins offline. Please call reception.
